scripts.text: Hm...after several days of observation, this place seems to be a device imprinted with the memories of an airship.
scripts.translation: 嗯...观察了好几天后，我觉得这里像是一台刻录着飞艇记忆的装置。

scripts.text: ...that is different. I don't have any more information...
scripts.translation: ...情况有些不同。我没有更多情报了...

scripts.translation: ^ff0000必须先组建或加入至少1人的队伍，才能进入此副本。^000000

scripts.translation: ^ff0000此记忆副本仅限1人进入，且只有队长可以进入。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000This Memorial Dungeon is only for 1 person. Only the party leader can enter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000此记忆副本仅限1人进入，且只有队长可以进入。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000To enter, you must create or join a party of 1 or more members.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000必须先组建或加入至少1人的队伍，才能进入此副本。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000The party leader has not used the device.^000000
...Glad there aren't any of those pesky things here...
scripts.translation: ...幸好这里没有那些讨厌的家伙...

scripts.text: ...I will defend this place no matter what. Go down into the airship...!!
scripts.translation: ...无论如何我都会守住这里。你们下到飞艇里面去...！！

scripts.text: Flying in the air through with the strength of machinery... the development of technology is truly marvelous.
scripts.translation: 靠机械的力量在空中飞行...科技的发展真是令人惊叹。

scripts.text: But I feel there's a power of some kind... I think this airship won't be able to fly solely just by technology.
scripts.translation: 不过我感觉到某种力量...我觉得这艘飞艇并非单凭科技就能飞行。

scripts.text: I will face them here. Chaos, go down to the lower floor of the airship with Iris!
scripts.translation: 我会在这里挡住他们。凯欧斯，和艾莉丝一起去飞艇下层！

scripts.text: Whoa~ this is great!! The wind is so cool~!!
scripts.translation: 哇~太棒了！！风吹起来好凉快~！！

scripts.text: Hooray~ we are flying through the sky! For free on top of that!
scripts.translation: 好耶~我们在天空中飞！而且还是免费的！

scripts.text: Is it not marvelous how this huge ship can fly without the use of magic? Chaos?
scripts.translation: 这艘巨大的船不用魔法也能飞，是不是很神奇？凯欧斯？

scripts.text: What are you doing instead of listening to me!!!!
scripts.translation: 你在干什么，根本没听我说话！！！！

scripts.text: Humph! That's what you get for being absent-minded!
scripts.translation: 哼！这就是心不在焉的下场！

scripts.text: Ah...Iris!! Are you trying to kill me~!!
scripts.translation: 啊...艾莉丝！！你想害死我吗~！！

scripts.text: Humph! I don't care if you die or not...
scripts.translation: 哼！你死不死我才不在乎...

scripts.text: Hey!! No horsing around on the ship!!
This is what's wrong with young humans. They have no manners! If you act up I will toss all of you off!!
scripts.translation: 现在的年轻人就是这样，一点礼貌也没有！再胡闹我就把你们全扔下去！！

scripts.text: Oops... By the way captain, how does this big airship fly through the sky? It is so marvelous!
scripts.translation: 哎呀...对了船长，这么大的飞艇是怎么在天上飞的？太神奇了！

scripts.text: As you can see, we heat the large boiler to boil water then use the pressure of the steam to move the pistons which turns the cogwheel and moves the turbine to turn the propeller.
scripts.translation: 如你所见，我们加热大型锅炉把水烧开，再用蒸汽压力推动活塞，带动齿轮和涡轮，最后转动螺旋桨。

scripts.text: Eh... So that's how this big ship floats... but now the feeling of the mystery is gone. I thought there would be some mystical device... a little disappointed...
scripts.translation: 咦...原来这艘大船就是这样飞起来的...神秘感都没了。我还以为有什么神奇装置呢...有点失望...

scripts.text: That's right. This big ship can't be in the sky with just steam. So it uses an amplifier called a 'Rune Engine'.
scripts.translation: 没错。这艘大船不可能只靠蒸汽飞上天空，所以还用了一种叫作‘符文引擎’的增幅器。

scripts.text: It's a device that uses a magical stone.
scripts.translation: 那是一种利用魔法石的装置。

scripts.text: Something about fallen fragments of a broken heart according to the legends... a ridiculous legend but that doesn't matter...
scripts.translation: 传说那是破碎之心坠落后的碎片...这传说听起来很荒唐，不过无所谓...

scripts.text: The stone is the so-called 'Tear of Ymir.' If put in junction with locomotive engines like steam engines, the rune exuded from the stone amplifies the energy.
scripts.translation: 那块石头就是所谓的‘伊米尔之泪’。把它连接到蒸汽机之类的动力装置上，石头散发的符文就能增强能量。

scripts.text: In all honesty it is not an overstatement to say a rock the size of a thumb is moving this ship. It possesses an incredible power.
scripts.translation: 说实话，说这艘船是由一块拇指大小的石头推动的，一点也不夸张。它蕴含着惊人的力量。

scripts.text: Alert!! Alert!! A large Wyvern unit at 7 o'clock!!
scripts.translation: 警报！！警报！！七点钟方向发现大型飞龙群！！

scripts.text: Gre...Gremlins!! Gremlins have landed from the Wyvern!!
scripts.translation: 哥...哥布灵！！哥布灵从飞龙上登陆了！！
哈哈哈哈~让你们久等了！！

scripts.text: Beautiful sorceress Arcana's surprise airborne monster show!!
scripts.translation: 美丽魔女阿卡娜的空中魔物惊奇秀！！

scripts.text: Now... Let us get started! Gremlins~!!
Gremlins are all over the ship!!
scripts.translation: 哥布灵已经爬满整艘船了！！

scripts.text: You bastards!! Come down from there now!!
scripts.translation: 你们这些混蛋！！马上给我下来！！

scripts.text: Captain. There is no need to be so agitated.
Gremlins are just monsters that tinker with machines. Rather...
scripts.translation: 哥布灵不过是些喜欢捣鼓机器的魔物。倒是...

scripts.text: You don't know what you're talking about!!
We're at an altitude of 8000!! Even a minor malfunction could lead to a deadly crash!
scripts.translation: 我们现在在8000的高空！！哪怕一点小故障都可能导致坠毁！

scripts.text: ...This is serious! They are heading towards the engine room! We have to protect the Rune Engine!!
scripts.translation: ...情况不妙！它们正往引擎室去！我们必须保护符文引擎！！

scripts.text: Damn it... Where did I put my weapon...
scripts.translation: 可恶...我的武器放哪儿了...

scripts.text: Hey humans!! Block that nuisance while I go to the captain's room to look for my weapon!!
scripts.translation: 喂，人类！！我去船长室找武器，你们先挡住那些捣乱的家伙！！

scripts.text: We have to especially stop them from getting to the Rune Engine!! If that is destroyed the ship can no longer fly!!
scripts.translation: 一定要阻止它们靠近符文引擎！！引擎一旦被毁，飞艇就飞不了了！！

scripts.text: Damn... if only I had my weapon...
scripts.translation: 可恶...要是我有武器就好了...

scripts.text: Iris!! Let's go down to the engine room! Loki and Fenrir, hold this place!
scripts.translation: 艾莉丝！！我们下到引擎室去！洛基、芬里尔，守住这里！

scripts.text: Should I cut them all down? ...No it is not enough money for me to be involved...
scripts.translation: 要把它们全砍了吗？...不，报酬不够，我才不掺和...

scripts.text: How dare you interrupt my precious meal time! Guard! Where are you!
scripts.translation: 竟敢打扰我宝贵的用餐时间！警卫！你们在哪儿！

scripts.text: Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~
scripts.translation: 连船爆炸都这么震撼~哇~

scripts.text: They might look menacing but those monsters are also customers to my cafeteria.
scripts.translation: 那些魔物看起来很凶，不过也是我餐厅的顾客。

scripts.text: What would you like monster customer?
Off with your hands and neck!
scripts.translation: 把你的手和脖子都拿开！

scripts.text: I was just getting a feel for this and these monsters show up?! Are you trying to steal my money because I won a little? Huh?!
scripts.translation: 我刚找到点手感，这些魔物就跑出来了？！你们是看我赢了点钱，就想抢我的钱吗？！

scripts.text: This is the entrance to the engine room. Stop them from getting in!
scripts.translation: 这里是引擎室入口。别让它们进去！

scripts.text: Damn... There are too many of them! The engine room could get overrun!!
scripts.translation: 可恶...它们太多了！引擎室要守不住了！！

scripts.text: We must not waken our sleeping King no matter what happens!
scripts.translation: 无论发生什么，都不能惊醒正在休息的国王！

scripts.text: Damn... They have already reached this far! Thanks to you the Rune Engine was defended.
scripts.translation: 可恶...它们已经推进到这里了！多亏了你们，符文引擎才保住了。

scripts.text: Uh...oh!! There's a gremlin heading towards the engine room!!
scripts.translation: 呃...不好！！有只哥布灵正朝引擎室去！！

scripts.text: Argh! The Rune Engine!! The engine room has exploded!! Fire suppression team! Put out the fire!!
scripts.translation: 啊！符文引擎！！引擎室爆炸了！！消防队！快灭火！！

scripts.text: Damn it!! It's dangerous here! Let's get out of here first! Iris, hurry!!
scripts.translation: 该死！！这里很危险！先离开这里！艾莉丝，快点！！

scripts.text: It's going to explode! Have to go over... I have to go over to that Airship on the other side!!
scripts.translation: 要爆炸了！得过去...我得去对面的飞艇！！

scripts.text: Even the exploding ship is incredible~ Whoa~
scripts.translation: 连船爆炸都这么震撼~哇~

scripts.text: Is this ship.. going to fall..
However I will share fate with this ship. This ship and I are one!
scripts.translation: 不过，我会与这艘船共存亡。这艘船就是我的一部分！

scripts.text: As expected. Our intuition wasn't wrong. It was fruitful to have followed the wave of evil and come this far.
scripts.translation: 果然，我们的直觉没错。追踪邪恶浪潮来到这里，确实有所收获。
我们是无敌的游侠战队！

scripts.text: Hm? What's with the reaction? Everybody is kind of a lukewarm... Was it too much?
scripts.translation: 嗯？反应怎么这么冷淡？大家好像都不太热情...是不是表现过头了？

scripts.text: Hm, no, no. Everybody is just captivated by our great entrance.
scripts.translation: 嗯，不，不。大家只是被我们华丽的登场迷住了。

scripts.text: Right, right. This much production for a hero's entrance is a bit too much!!
scripts.translation: 是啊是啊，为了英雄登场搞这么大阵仗，确实有点过头了！！

scripts.text: Are those stage costumes? Are they celebrities and not heroes?
scripts.translation: 那是舞台服装吗？他们是名人，不是英雄吧？

scripts.text: Humph. You don't know what you're talking about!
Do you know how much these clothes cost? That is what's wrong with people who are dull to the latest fashion~
scripts.translation: 你知道这些衣服有多贵吗？这就是你们这些不懂时尚的人的问题~

scripts.text: You guys! This isn't the time to be chatting like this! Let's root out the wave of evil!!
scripts.translation: 你们几个！现在不是闲聊的时候！赶快消灭这股邪恶浪潮！！

scripts.text: Roger, Basara! Let's end it with a swift attack!!
scripts.translation: 收到，婆娑罗！让我们速战速决！！

scripts.text: What, what are they... Absolute morons...
scripts.translation: 什、什么啊...简直是一群白痴...

scripts.text: This could turn out to be a fun party~
scripts.translation: 看来会是一场有趣的派对~

scripts.text: It would be better to end this party now... What is this? Did Freyja send you?
scripts.translation: 差不多该结束这场派对了...怎么，你是芙蕾雅派来的吗？

scripts.text: How dare a mere lowly human say Freyja's name.
scripts.translation: 区区一个人类，竟敢直呼芙蕾雅的名字。

scripts.text: As expected. You are Freyja's pawn?
scripts.translation: 果然如此。你是芙蕾雅的棋子？

scripts.text: ...Careful. If you keep going on like that...
You will receive a divine punishment!
Okay~ I will show you something good. Something to cool your heads.
scripts.translation: 好啊~我给你们看点好东西，让你们冷静一下。

scripts.text: Ooh.. you threw back Wyvern's Breath... an unexpected outcome. But can you withstand this one?
scripts.translation: 哦...你们挡下了飞龙吐息...真出乎意料。不过这招你们挡得住吗？

scripts.text: You! I will face one while you face the other...
scripts.translation: 你！我对付一个，你去对付另一个...

scripts.text: Eek! There are still more of these!!

scripts.translation: 找到了！我的武器！嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text: I will show you what happens when you attack my ship!
scripts.translation: 让你们看看袭击我的船会有什么下场！

scripts.text: I will end this with my specially manufactured Exodus Joker XIII Doom Rifle!
scripts.translation: 我就用特别订制的末日小丑十三型毁灭步枪解决你们！

scripts.text: You're really going to fire that?!
What?! Those bastards are breaking the engine more?!! You're making me angry!!
scripts.translation: 什么？！那群混蛋还在破坏引擎？！你们惹怒我了！！

scripts.text: You're the one who did it!!!
The way things are going the ship will crash because of that reindeer captain!! Stop that captain!! I'm scared...
scripts.translation: 照这样下去，飞艇会被那只驯鹿船长弄坠毁的！！快阻止船长！！我好害怕...

scripts.text: How can we stop him? ...Maybe he will regain his senses if you beat him just enough to not die... I'm counting on you!!
scripts.translation: 我们怎么阻止他？...也许把他打到半死，他就会清醒...拜托你了！！

scripts.text: You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
scripts.translation: 你现在快离开这里！！这艘船很危险！！

scripts.text: Oops.. I was shooting like crazy. Looks like a lot of the Gremlins are gone? Hehehehe
scripts.translation: 哎呀...我刚才一通乱射。看来哥布灵少了不少？嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text: The ship is damaged because of you!!
Doing our work for us. Hm, I guess this is enough?
scripts.translation: 替我们做了该做的事。嗯，我想这样就够了？

scripts.text: Then it's time for us to slip away...
scripts.translation: 那么我们该悄悄溜走了...

scripts.text: Oh? ... There, Basara. Looks like they are retreating.
scripts.translation: 哦？...看那边，婆娑罗。他们好像在撤退。

scripts.text: Of course!! They got a sense of our skill!! Hohoho~
scripts.translation: 那当然！！他们感受到我们的实力了！！呵呵呵~

scripts.text: On that note, one last Huuma Metal Shuriken!!
scripts.translation: 最后再来一发风魔金属手里剑！！
呀！！我们好像要掉下去了！！

scripts.text: ...A place I can't reach like before...
scripts.translation: ...又是一个像以前一样到不了的地方...

scripts.text: What are you looking at? Here, come up...

scripts.translation: 确认所有引擎都已停止！！

scripts.text: Board the lifeboats with the passengers being first priority! Release the lifeboats that have completed boarding!
scripts.translation: 优先让乘客登上救生艇！乘客登满的救生艇立即放下！

scripts.text: Wait!! There are still people remaining!!
If we keep stalling the rest will be in danger!! It's too bad but we have done all we can!
scripts.translation: 继续耽搁下去，其他人也会有危险！！虽然很遗憾，但我们已经尽力了！

scripts.text: But the remaining people are precious lives as well! You're going to leave them?!! Huh?!!
scripts.translation: 可是留下的人也是宝贵的生命！你们要抛下他们吗？！啊？！

scripts.text: On that note I will leave you to take care of the aftermath. I'm off!!
scripts.translation: 那么善后就交给你们了，我先走一步！！

scripts.text: Hey! Where are you going! Argh!!
I will catch you. I will kill you!!
It is not the time for us to be facing these trivial Gremlins.
scripts.translation: 现在不是对付这些小小哥布灵的时候。

scripts.text: I can feel a larger wave of evil.
scripts.translation: 我感受到更强大的邪恶浪潮。

scripts.text: Let's leave these little ones to them. Let's go!
scripts.translation: 这些小家伙就交给他们吧。我们走！

scripts.text: Where do you think you're going after destroying the ship?!
scripts.translation: 毁了飞艇还想跑到哪里去？！

scripts.text: If I catch you next time I will make sure you die!! Be nervous!! You got it?! Be ready, you yokels!!
scripts.translation: 下次被我抓到就死定了！！给我提心吊胆地过日子！！听见了吗？！等着瞧吧，你们这些乡巴佬！！

scripts.text: The ones who denigrate and condemn the path of righteousness... We should mercilessly hand down righteous judgment, right?
scripts.translation: 那些诋毁、谴责正义之道的人...就该毫不留情地施以正义的审判，对吧？
恶徒，去死吧！！风魔金属手里剑！！

scripts.text: Let's quickly find Fenrir and Loki and get out of here!!
scripts.translation: 快去找芬里尔和洛基，然后离开这里！！

scripts.text: You get out of here now!! This ship is in danger!!
scripts.translation: 你现在快离开这里！！这艘船很危险！！
